name: Kataomoi no Tsubasa
source:
Agressor; that is the power that lets people fly like birds.
The boys fly freely, engage in splendid fights and fall in love awkwardly, unaware of their cruel fate.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6569]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
“Agressor”，是让人能够像鸟儿一样飞翔的力量。
少年们自由地翱翔于天际，华丽地战斗，笨拙地恋爱，浑然不知残酷的命运正等待着他们。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6569]NovelGame[/url]]
